BETHESDA, Md., April. 18, 2023 – Lockheed Martin Corporation [NYSE: LMT] today reported first quarter 2023 net sales of $15.1 billion, compared to $15.0 billion in the first quarter of 2022. Net earnings in the first quarter of 2023 were $1.7 billion, or $6.61 per share, compared to $1.7 billion, or $6.44 per share, in the first quarter of 2022. Cash from operations was $1.6 billion in the first quarter of 2023, compared to $1.4 billion in the first quarter of 2022. Free cash flow was $1.3 billion in the first quarter of 2023, compared to $1.1 billion in the first quarter of 2022.
